feedback: PRD is well-structured and accurate. Appendices A/B match the actual hello.py and test_hello.py byte-for-byte. Goals, non-goals, 4 user stories, 13 FRs, 7 ATs, NFRs, risks (with mitigations), open questions, and a traceability matrix are all present and substantive. Requirements are testable and unambiguous (exact signature, exact strings, exact CLI output pinned). Rigor is proportional to this trivial refactor. No blocking findings.

findings.message: FR-2 mandates concatenation form 'hello ' + name but also calls f-string equivalent — both are fine; consider just specifying the resulting string contract to avoid any over-prescription of implementation form.
